## Accounting

This is an R Markdown document I designed to automate the processes of Tanzeel Ahmed Transportation's Accounting. Prior to creating this document, I used to have separate excel workbooks with multiple sheets where I would have to use pivot tables to summarize my general ledger.

However, I created this document so I could have just one database that contains every transaction my company has had since its inception in 2018.

This document can also streamline depreciation, amortization, loan calculations,and accrued income taxes automatically, saving me the headache of having to enter more reptitive manual transactions.

For ease, make sure to run these codes in the R console, not the markdown file.

install.packages('readxl') install.packages('lubridate') install.packages('dplyr') install.packages('ggplot2')
install.packages('openxlsx')

Then the following chunk will load them into the library for the purposes of this markdown document.

```{r Load Packages, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)

```

First, let's create functions to list the first and last day of any given year or last days of any given month within a year. I need to also establish a variable for the current year, so this document can be scaled and updated whenever I need to produce new financial statements. This will make it easier to automatically calculate adjusting entries in the future.

```{r First and Last Day of Year Functions, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

#First Day of the Year Function
first_day_of_year_function=function(year_no){
  leap_year_vec=c()
  for(i in 1970:year_no){
    if(i%%4==0){
      leap_year_status=TRUE
    }else{
      leap_year_status=FALSE
    }
    leap_year_vec=c(leap_year_vec,leap_year_status)
  }
  
#Remember, since the Leap Day is in February, the first day of a leap year should not account for the leap day that is yet to occur in said year.
  if(year_no%%4==0){
    date_no=(year_no-1970)*365+(sum(as.numeric(leap_year_vec))-1)
  }else{
    date_no=(year_no-1970)*365+(sum(as.numeric(leap_year_vec)))
  }
  date=as.Date(date_no,"1970-01-01")
  return(date)
}

#Now, let's create the last day of the year function
last_day_of_year_function=function(year_no){
  leap_year_vec=c()
  for(i in 1970:year_no){
    if(i%%4==0){
      leap_year_status=TRUE
    }else{
      leap_year_status=FALSE
    }
    leap_year_vec=c(leap_year_vec,leap_year_status)
  }
  date_no=(year_no+1-1970)*365+sum(as.numeric(leap_year_vec))-1
  date=as.Date(date_no,"1970-01-01")
  return(date)
}

#Function to create first day of the month.
first_day_of_month_function=function(year_no){
  first_day=first_day_of_year_function(year_no)
  first_day_vec=seq.Date(from=first_day,by="month",length.out=12)
  return(first_day_vec)
}

#Function to create last day of the month.
last_day_of_month_function=function(year_no){
  first_day=first_day_of_year_function(year_no)
  first_day_vec=seq.Date(from=first_day,by="month",length.out = 13)
  last_day_vec=first_day_vec[2:13]-1
  return(last_day_vec)
}

#Establish a variable for the current year
current_year=year(Sys.Date())
```

### Adjusting Entries

Next, I created vectors that specified which accounts in the general ledger have normal debit balances and credit balances.I then refer to these as sub-accounts and group them into more general accounts (i.e. different types of prepaid expenses are grouped into one "Prepaid Expenses" category.) I then categorize whether these general accounts affect the balance sheet or income statement since they have the most detail.I summarize this with the Account List dataframe, which can be used to streamline the automatic calculation of custom financial statements..

```{r Add Depreciation and Amortization Transactions, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

#Create transactions based on the imported depreciation_amortization table

da_transaction_function=function(da_table){
  
  #Establish the final data-frame as the result of this function
  result_df=data.frame()
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(da_table)){
    date=as.Date(seq.POSIXt(from=da_table$Start_Date[i],to=da_table$End_Date[i],by="month"))
    date=c(date[1],ceiling_date(date,unit="months")-1)

    #Make sure the last entry of the date vector is either the end date or the most recent        #date
    if(date[length(date)]>da_table$End_Date[i]){
      date[length(date)]=da_table$End_Date[i]
    }else{
      date[length(date)]=date[length(date)]
    }
   
  #Calculate the total number of days between the start and end dates of each transaction  
    total_days=as.numeric(da_table$End_Date[i]-da_table$Start_Date[i])
  
  #Establish new vectors for calculating debits, credits, the transaction dates, and
  #the transaction amounts for the resulting clean data-frame
    da_debit_vec=c()
    da_credit_vec=c()
    transaction_date_vec=c()
    amount_vec=c()

    for(j in 2:length(date)){
      no_days=date[j]-date[j-1]
      transaction_date=date[j]
      amount=no_days/total_days*da_table$Primary_Amount[i]
      amount_vec=c(amount_vec,amount)
      transaction_date_vec=c(transaction_date_vec,transaction_date)
      transaction_date_vec=as.Date(transaction_date_vec,"1970-01-01")
    }

  #Create a loop to iterate through the rows of the input file to determine whether a
  #transaction is a Debit or a Credit
    
    if(account_list_df$Normal_Balance[account_list_df$Sub_Account==da_table$Secondary_Account[i]]
    =="Debit"){
      da_debit_vec=c(rep(0,length(amount_vec)),amount_vec)
      da_credit_vec=c(amount_vec,rep(0,length(amount_vec)))
    }else{
      da_credit_vec=c(rep(0,length(amount_vec)),amount_vec)
      da_debit_vec=c(amount_vec,rep(0,length(amount_vec)))
    }
    
  #Create data-frames for the debits and credits, and then append the transaction dates
  # as well as appending the name of the secondary transactions. These will be translated
  # as transactions in the general ledger, which reduces repetitive entries by using
  # this function to automate recurring transactions
    
    da_debit_credit_df=data.frame(Debit=da_debit_vec,Credit=da_credit_vec)
    transaction_date_vec=c(transaction_date_vec,transaction_date_vec)
    transaction_vec=c(rep(da_table$Secondary_Transaction[i],length(amount_vec)*2))

  #Combine all the vectors into a new dataframe that is standardized to later be appended
  #to the general ledger.
    
    da_df=data.frame(Date=transaction_date_vec,Transaction=transaction_vec,da_debit_credit_df,
       Sub_Account=c(rep(da_table$Primary_Account[i],nrow(da_debit_credit_df)/2),
          rep(da_table$Secondary_Account[i],nrow(da_debit_credit_df)/2)),
       Vehicle=rep(da_table$Vehicle[i],length(transaction_date_vec)))
    
    result_df=rbind(result_df,da_df)
  }
  
  #Combine the dataframes iterated through each and every row into a final resulting dataframe
  return(result_df)
}

#Calculate depreciation and amortization transactions, using the newly created function
da_transaction_df=da_transaction_function(da_table)

```

### Finalize General Ledger

Now let's combine the depreciation and amoritzation transactions alongside the loan transactions to the a modified version of the general ledger and call it the final general ledger. I also create new fields that calculate the increase in an accounts normal balance, whether or not the balance sheet or income statement are affected.

```{r Make Loan and Depreciaton Transactions have the right amount of columns for rbind function, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

da_transaction_df=cbind(da_transaction_df,Verified="Y",Financial.Institution="Non-Cash")

#No longer using loan transactions dataframe
#loan_transactions=cbind(loan_transactions,Verified="Y",Financial.Institution="Non-Cash")

```

```{r Finalize the General Ledger, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

#Append the depreciation and amortization transactions to the general ledager

final_general_ledger=rbind(general_ledger,da_transaction_df)
                           #No longer using loan transactions data-frame loan_transactions)
final_general_ledger=final_general_ledger[order(final_general_ledger$Date,
              final_general_ledger$Transaction,-final_general_ledger$Debit),]

#Add Additional Column to show the increase or decrease in the account's normal column
normal_balance_increase_vec=c()

for(i in 1:nrow(final_general_ledger)){
  normal_balance_class=account_list_df$Normal_Balance[account_list_df$Sub_Account==final_general_ledger$Sub_Account[i]]
  if(normal_balance_class=="Debit"){
    normal_balance_increase=final_general_ledger$Debit[i]-final_general_ledger$Credit[i]
  }else if(normal_balance_class=="Credit"){
    normal_balance_increase=final_general_ledger$Credit[i]-final_general_ledger$Debit[i]
  }else{
    normal_balance_increase=0
  }
  normal_balance_increase_vec=c(normal_balance_increase_vec,normal_balance_increase)
}

#Add additional column to show which financial statement each transaction should affect.
statement_transaction_vec=c()

for(i in 1:nrow(final_general_ledger)){
  statement_transaction=account_list_df$Statement[account_list_df$Sub_Account==final_general_ledger$Sub_Account[i]]
  statement_transaction_vec=c(statement_transaction_vec,statement_transaction)
}

#Add additional column to show which general account the transaction account falls into.
general_account_vec=c()

for(i in 1:nrow(final_general_ledger)){
  general_account=account_list_df$Account[account_list_df$Sub_Account==final_general_ledger$Sub_Account[i]]
  general_account_vec=c(general_account_vec,general_account)
}

#Add calculated fields for Normal Balance Increase, the General Account (derived based on the
#provided Sub-Account and the Account List Schema), and the impacted Financial Statement
#Either (Income Statement or Balance Sheet)

final_general_ledger=data.frame(final_general_ledger,Normal_Balance_Increase=normal_balance_increase_vec,General_Account=general_account_vec,Statement=statement_transaction_vec)
```

### Rental Adjustment Entries

Create data frame that lists end of month adjustments for the depreciation, licensing, and insurance expenses associated with vehicles that are leased to customers. These adjustments will help me segment my income statement statements to determine how much income is attributable to driving and how much income is attributable to rentals.

If a vehicle is rented for less than one month, I will not count the depreciation and licensing, since the vehicle will be used for my driving operations and I would therefore be responsible with the licensing, registration, emissions inspections, and insurance anyway.Insurance can still be calculated based on the depreciation and amortization table and accurately account for the additional insurance costs I had to take in the short-term. Repairs and Maintenance items will not be included since they will already be labeled as Rental Fleet Repairs and Maintenance in the general ledger.

For simplicity, I will not add these to the general ledger since the underlying assets associated with the accumulated depreciation, prepaid licensing, and prepaid insurance accounts do not change.

```{r Rental Adjustments, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
#Function to determine the average daily vehicle licensing, insurance, and depreciation amounts while a car is rented.Since rental start and end dates do not necessarily line up with the first and last day of a month, the insurance, depreciation, and licensing costs per day can vary. For transactional purposes, this tends to increase rental fleet cost apportionments marginally (assuming rentals longer than one month). Since insurance costs and accrual accounting are calculated on a monthly basis, I choose not to change the final transactions.


rental_adjustment_function=function(ledger,rental_date_df){
  avg_daily_licensing_vec=c()
  avg_daily_insurance_vec=c()
  avg_daily_depreciation_vec=c()
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(rental_date_df)){
    no_days=as.numeric(rental_date_df$End_Date[i]-rental_date_df$Start_Date[i])
    no_months=as.numeric(month(as.Date(rental_date_df$End_Date[i]))-month(as.Date(rental_date_df$Start_Date[i])))
    
    #Calculate Average Repairs and Maintenance for entire rental period
    licensing=subset(ledger,ledger$Date>=rental_date_df$Start_Date[i]&ledger$Date<=rental_date_df$End_Date[i]&ledger$Vehicle==rental_date_df$Vehicle[i]&ledger$General_Account=="Vehicle Licensing and Registration")
    licensing_amount=sum(licensing$Normal_Balance_Increase)
    avg_daily_licensing=licensing_amount/no_days
    avg_daily_licensing_vec=c(avg_daily_licensing_vec,
                                        avg_daily_licensing)
    
    #Calculate Average Insurance for entire rental period
    insurance=subset(ledger,ledger$Date>=rental_date_df$Start_Date[i]&ledger$Date<=rental_date_df$End_Date[i]&ledger$Vehicle==rental_date_df$Vehicle[i]&ledger$General_Account=="Insurance")
    insurance_amount=sum(insurance$Normal_Balance_Increase)
    avg_daily_insurance=insurance_amount/no_days
    avg_daily_insurance_vec=c(avg_daily_insurance_vec,avg_daily_insurance)

    #Calculate Average Depreciation for entire rental period
    depreciation=subset(ledger,ledger$Date>=rental_date_df$Start_Date[i]&ledger$Date<=rental_date_df$End_Date[i]&ledger$Vehicle==rental_date_df$Vehicle[i]&ledger$General_Account=="Depreciation")
    depreciation_amount=sum(depreciation$Normal_Balance_Increase)
    avg_daily_depreciation=depreciation_amount/no_days
    avg_daily_depreciation_vec=c(avg_daily_depreciation_vec,avg_daily_depreciation)
  }
  final_df=data.frame(Licensing=avg_daily_licensing_vec,Insurance=avg_daily_insurance_vec,Depreciation=avg_daily_depreciation_vec)
  return(final_df)
}

#To avoid confusion, the sub-accounts and general_accounts will remain intact. The adjustments will be made to the income statement calculations to properly show which segments are producing income.

rental_adjustment_transaction_function=function(ledger,rental_date_df){
  rental_adjustment_df=rental_adjustment_function(ledger,rental_date_df)
  final_df=data.frame()
  for(i in 1:nrow(rental_date_df)){
    final_transaction_date_vec=c()
    transaction_date_vec=c()
    
    start_date=as.Date(rental_date_df$Start_Date[i])
    end_date=as.Date(rental_date_df$End_Date[i])
    
    start_year=year(start_date)
    end_year=year(end_date)
    
    start_year_transaction_dates=last_day_of_month_function(start_year)
    end_year_transaction_dates=last_day_of_month_function(end_year)
    
    transaction_date_vec=c(start_year_transaction_dates,end_year_transaction_dates)
    
    #Remove duplicates so you're not counting the same year twice if the rental does not cross into the new year.
    
    transaction_date_vec=unique(transaction_date_vec)
    
    transaction_date_vec=transaction_date_vec[transaction_date_vec>start_date&                 transaction_date_vec<end_date]
    
    final_transaction_date_vec=c(start_date,transaction_date_vec,end_date)
    
    licensing_amount_vec=c()
    depreciation_amount_vec=c()
    insurance_amount_vec=c()
    no_days_vec=c()
    
    #Make sure to count the number of days from the second observation of the transaction date vector to determine how many days it has been since you first rented the car.
    
    for(j in 2:length(final_transaction_date_vec)){
      no_days=as.numeric(final_transaction_date_vec[j]-final_transaction_date_vec[j-1])
      licensing_amount=rental_adjustment_df$Licensing[i]*no_days
      depreciation_amount=rental_adjustment_df$Depreciation[i]*no_days
      insurance_amount=rental_adjustment_df$Insurance[i]*no_days
      
      no_days_vec=c(no_days_vec,no_days)
      licensing_amount_vec=c(licensing_amount_vec,licensing_amount)
      depreciation_amount_vec=c(depreciation_amount_vec,depreciation_amount)
      insurance_amount_vec=c(insurance_amount_vec,insurance_amount)
    }
    final_transaction_date_vec=final_transaction_date_vec[2:length(final_transaction_date_vec)]
    transaction_df=data.frame(Date=final_transaction_date_vec,
                              Licensing=licensing_amount_vec,
                              Depreciation=depreciation_amount_vec,
                              Insurance=insurance_amount_vec,
                              No_Days=no_days_vec)
    final_df=rbind(final_df,transaction_df)
  }
  return(final_df)
}

rental_adjustment_transaction_df=rental_adjustment_transaction_function(final_general_ledger,rental_date_df)
```

Next, make adjustments for cash reconciliations based on end-of-quarter and end-of-year cash balances.

```{r Cash Reconciliation Entries, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
#To avoid confusion, the sub-accounts and general_accounts will remain intact. The adjustments will be made to the income statement calculations to properly show which segments are producing income.

rental_adjustment_transaction_function=function(ledger,rental_date_df){
  rental_adjustment_df=rental_adjustment_function(ledger,rental_date_df)
  final_df=data.frame()
  for(i in 1:nrow(rental_date_df)){
    final_transaction_date_vec=c()
    transaction_date_vec=c()
    
    start_date=as.Date(rental_date_df$Start_Date[i])
    end_date=as.Date(rental_date_df$End_Date[i])
    
    start_year=year(start_date)
    end_year=year(end_date)
    
    start_year_transaction_dates=last_day_of_month_function(start_year)
    end_year_transaction_dates=last_day_of_month_function(end_year)
    
    transaction_date_vec=c(start_year_transaction_dates,end_year_transaction_dates)
    
    #Remove duplicates so you're not counting the same year twice if the rental does not cross into the new year.
    
    transaction_date_vec=unique(transaction_date_vec)
    
    transaction_date_vec=transaction_date_vec[transaction_date_vec>start_date&                 transaction_date_vec<end_date]
    
    final_transaction_date_vec=c(start_date,transaction_date_vec,end_date)
    
    licensing_amount_vec=c()
    depreciation_amount_vec=c()
    insurance_amount_vec=c()
    no_days_vec=c()
    
    #Make sure to count the number of days from the second observation of the transaction date vector to determine how many days it has been since you first rented the car.
    
    for(j in 2:length(final_transaction_date_vec)){
      no_days=as.numeric(final_transaction_date_vec[j]-final_transaction_date_vec[j-1])
      licensing_amount=rental_adjustment_df$Licensing[i]*no_days
      depreciation_amount=rental_adjustment_df$Depreciation[i]*no_days
      insurance_amount=rental_adjustment_df$Insurance[i]*no_days
      
      no_days_vec=c(no_days_vec,no_days)
      licensing_amount_vec=c(licensing_amount_vec,licensing_amount)
      depreciation_amount_vec=c(depreciation_amount_vec,depreciation_amount)
      insurance_amount_vec=c(insurance_amount_vec,insurance_amount)
    }
    final_transaction_date_vec=final_transaction_date_vec[2:length(final_transaction_date_vec)]
    transaction_df=data.frame(Date=final_transaction_date_vec,
                              Licensing=licensing_amount_vec,
                              Depreciation=depreciation_amount_vec,
                              Insurance=insurance_amount_vec,
                              No_Days=no_days_vec)
    final_df=rbind(final_df,transaction_df)
  }
  return(final_df)
}

rental_adjustment_transaction_df=rental_adjustment_transaction_function(final_general_ledger,rental_date_df)
```

### Create Financial Statements

I create functions to calculate pre-tax income statements on an annual and monthly basis to aid in the calculation of effective income taxes by year and end-of-month adjusting entries.

```{r Calculate Pre-tax Income Statements, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

#Calculate Annual Pre-tax Income Statements. You'll need to do this so you can impute the effective tax rate you paid in any given year. This will allow you to add tax transactions to the ledger and then re-calculate an income statement that includes income taxes, dividends, and increases in retained earnings.

annual_pre_tax_income_statement_function=function(ledger,year_no){
  #Start and End Dates given the year number.
  start_date=first_day_of_year_function(year_no)
  end_date=last_day_of_year_function(year_no)
  
  #Account Balances of Income Statement Accounts
  is_account_balance_df=ledger%>%
    filter(Date>=as.Date(start_date)&Date<=as.Date(end_date)&Statement=="Income Statement")%>%
    group_by(General_Account)%>%
    summarize(Balance=round(sum(Normal_Balance_Increase),2))
  
  #Assign the account balances to actual values. I Use sums in case financial statement query generates nulls. (i.e. Fleet Carma Rewards did not exist until I bought an electric car)
  
  administrative_expenses=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Administrative Expenses"])
  
  advertising=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Advertising"])
  
  bad_debt_expense=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Bad Debt Expense"])
  
  depreciation=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Depreciation"])
  dividends=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Dividends"])
  
  driver_licensing=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Driver Licensing"])
  
  electricity=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Electricity"])
  
  fleet_carma_rewards=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Fleet Carma Rewards"])
  
  gas=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Gas"])
  insurance=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Insurance"])
  interest=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Interest"])
  parking=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Parking"])
  tolls=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Tolls"])
  tlc_rental=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="TLC Rental"])
  
  vehicle_accessories=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Accessories"])
  
  vehicle_cleaning=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Cleaning"])
  
  vehicle_licensing_and_registration=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Licensing and Registration"])
  
  vehicle_repairs_and_maintenance=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Repairs and Maintenance"])
  
  driver_revenue=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Driver Revenue"])
  rental_revenue=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Rental Revenue"])
  
  rental_fleet_depreciation=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Rental Fleet Depreciation"])
  
  rental_fleet_maintenance=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Rental Fleet Maintenance"])
  
  rental_fleet_insurance=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Rental Fleet Insurance"])
  
  sales_taxes=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Sales Taxes"])
  
  gain_on_disposal_of_assets=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Other Income"])
  
  loss_on_disposal_of_assets=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Other Loss"])
  
  salary_expenses=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Salary Expenses"])
  
  payroll_tax_expenses=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Employer Payroll Tax Expense"])
  
  #Calculate Income Statement Values
  sga=administrative_expenses+advertising+salary_expenses+payroll_tax_expenses
  
  vehicle_expenses=vehicle_accessories+vehicle_cleaning+vehicle_licensing_and_registration+vehicle_repairs_and_maintenance+tlc_rental+depreciation+insurance
  
  fuel_expenses=gas+electricity-fleet_carma_rewards
  
  driver_expenses=vehicle_expenses+fuel_expenses+driver_licensing+tolls+parking
  
  net_driver_revenue=driver_revenue-driver_expenses
  
  net_rental_revenue=rental_revenue-sales_taxes
  
  gross_revenue=net_rental_revenue+driver_revenue
  
  net_revenue=net_rental_revenue+net_driver_revenue
  
  rental_fleet_expenses=rental_fleet_insurance+rental_fleet_depreciation+rental_fleet_maintenance+bad_debt_expense
  
  other_net_income=gain_on_disposal_of_assets-loss_on_disposal_of_assets
  
  ebit=net_revenue-sga-rental_fleet_expenses-other_net_income
  
  ebt=ebit-interest
  
  tanzeel_ahmed_compensation=salary_expenses+payroll_tax_expenses

  #Create Dataframe for the final income statement.Column names will have space indents.
  is_df=data.frame(gross_revenue,driver_revenue,driver_expenses,vehicle_expenses,fuel_expenses,driver_licensing, tolls,parking,net_driver_revenue,rental_revenue,sales_taxes,net_rental_revenue,net_revenue,sga,tanzeel_ahmed_compensation,rental_fleet_expenses,rental_fleet_insurance, rental_fleet_depreciation, rental_fleet_maintenance,other_net_income,ebit,interest,ebt)
  
  colnames(is_df)=c("GROSS REVENUE","Driver Revenue","Driver Expenses","Vehicle Expenses",    "Fuel Expenses","Driver Licensing","Tolls","Parking","Net Driver Revenue","RENTAL REVENUE","Sales Taxes","NET RENTAL REVENUE","NET REVENUE","Selling, General, and Administrative Expenses","Tanzeel Ahmed Compensation","RENTAL FLEET EXPENSES", "Rental Fleet Insurance", "Rental Fleet Depreciation", "Rental Fleet Maintenance","Other Net Income","EBIT","Interest","PRE-TAX INCOME")
  
  is_df=data.frame(Sub_Account=colnames(is_df),Amount=t(is_df))
  return(is_df)
}
```

I then calculated effective tax rates for every year and calculate transactions for the general ledger (before I add the general account, statement, and normal balance increase fields).The income tax transaction function will calculate the general account, statementn and normal balance increase fields.

```{r Income Tax Calculations, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

#Calculate the effective tax rate using the annual pre-tax income statement function to calculate the effective tax rate in any given year.

effective_tax_function=function(ledger,income_tax_df){
  effective_tax_rate_vec=c()
  for(i in 1:nrow(income_tax_df)){
    pre_tax_is_df=annual_pre_tax_income_statement_function(ledger,income_tax_df$Year[i])
    pre_tax_income=pre_tax_is_df$Amount[pre_tax_is_df$Sub_Account=="PRE-TAX INCOME"]
    tax=income_tax_df$`Federal Income Tax`[i]+income_tax_df$`State Income Tax`[i]
    effective_tax_rate=tax/pre_tax_income
    effective_tax_rate_vec=c(effective_tax_rate_vec,effective_tax_rate)
  }
  result_df=data.frame(income_tax_df$Year,effective_tax_rate_vec)
  colnames(result_df)=c("Year","Rate")
  return(result_df)
}

income_tax_transaction_function=function(ledger,income_tax_df){
  final_df=data.frame()
  effective_tax_df=effective_tax_function(ledger,income_tax_df)
  transaction_date_vec=c()
  for(i in 1:nrow(effective_tax_df)){
    transaction_date=last_day_of_month_function(effective_tax_df$Year[i])
    transaction_date=c(transaction_date,transaction_date)
    transaction=c(rep("Accrued Income Taxes",24))
    account=c(rep("Income Tax Expense",12),rep("Income Taxes Payable",12))
    vehicle=c(rep("Administrative",24))
    monthly_is_df=monthly_pre_tax_income_statement_function(ledger,effective_tax_df$Year[i])
    debit_transactions=monthly_is_df$Amount[monthly_is_df$Account==
                                              "PRE-TAX INCOME"]*effective_tax_df$Rate[i]
    debit_transactions=c(debit_transactions,c(rep(0,length(debit_transactions))))
    credit_transactions=monthly_is_df$Amount[monthly_is_df$Account==
                                              "PRE-TAX INCOME"]*effective_tax_df$Rate[i]
    credit_transactions=c(rep(0,length(credit_transactions)),credit_transactions)
    transaction_df=data.frame(Date=transaction_date,Transaction=transaction,Debit=debit_transactions,
                              Credit=credit_transactions,Account=account,Vehicle=vehicle)
    final_df=rbind(final_df,transaction_df)
  }
  
  #Change column names to match the general ledger before you add normal balance increase, statement, and general account fields.
  colnames(final_df)=c("Date","Transaction","Debit","Credit","Sub_Account","Vehicle")
  
  #General Account
  general_account_vec=c()
  for(i in 1:nrow(final_df)){
    general_account=account_list_df$Account[account_list_df$Sub_Account==final_df$Sub_Account[i]]
    general_account_vec=c(general_account_vec,general_account)
  }
  
  #Add additional column to show which financial statement each transaction should affect.
  statement_transaction_vec=c()

  for(i in 1:nrow(final_df)){
    statement_transaction=account_list_df$Statement[account_list_df$Sub_Account==               final_df$Sub_Account[i]]
  statement_transaction_vec=c(statement_transaction_vec,statement_transaction)
}
  
  #Normal Balance Increase
  normal_balance_increase_vec=c()
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(final_df)){
  normal_balance_class=account_list_df$Normal_Balance[account_list_df$Sub_Account==final_df$Sub_Account[i]]
  if(normal_balance_class=="Debit"){
    normal_balance_increase=final_df$Debit[i]-final_df$Credit[i]
  }else{
    normal_balance_increase=final_df$Credit[i]-final_df$Debit[i]
  }
  normal_balance_increase_vec=c(normal_balance_increase_vec,normal_balance_increase)
  }
  
  #Add last three columns
  final_df=data.frame(final_df,Normal_Balance_Increase=normal_balance_increase_vec,General_Account=general_account_vec,Statement=statement_transaction_vec)
  return(final_df)
}

```

```{r Income Tax Transactions,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
income_tax_transaction_df=data.frame(income_tax_transaction_df[,c("Date","Transaction","Debit","Credit","Sub_Account","Vehicle")],Verified="Y",Financial.Institution="Non-Cash",income_tax_transaction_df[,c("Normal_Balance_Increase","General_Account","Statement")])
```

The final Income Statement Function accounts for the fact that annual and monthly pre-tax income statements needed to be calculated SEPARATELY in order to update the final general ledger with adjusting entries, some of which are accrued income taxes that require the separate calculation of the effective income tax rates for the corresponding years.

```{r After-Tax Income Statement Calculation, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

income_statement_function=function(ledger,start_date,end_date,rental_adjustment_transaction_df){
  #Make sure the start and end dates are properly formatted
  start_date=as.Date(start_date)
  end_date=as.Date(end_date)
  
  #Account Balances of Income Statement Accounts

    filter(Date>=as.Date(start_date)&Date<=as.Date(end_date)&Statement=="Income Statement")%>%
    group_by(General_Account)%>%
    summarize(Balance=round(sum(Normal_Balance_Increase),2))
  
  #Assign the account balances to actual values. I Use sums in case financial statement query generates nulls. (i.e. Fleet Carma Rewards did not exist until I bought an electric car). Now that I have a rental adjustment transaction data frame, I can also calculate the rental fleet values to properly segment the income statement.
  
  administrative_expenses=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Administrative Expenses"])
  advertising=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Advertising"])
  bad_debt_expense=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Bad Debt Expense"])
  depreciation=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Depreciation"])
  dividends=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Dividends"])
  driver_licensing=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Driver Licensing"])
  electricity=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Electricity"])
  fleet_carma_rewards=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Fleet Carma Rewards"])
  gas=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Gas"])
  insurance=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Insurance"])
  interest=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Interest"])
  parking=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Parking"])
  tolls=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Tolls"])
  tlc_rental=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="TLC Rental"])
  vehicle_accessories=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Accessories"])
  vehicle_cleaning=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Cleaning"])
  vehicle_licensing_and_registration=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Licensing and Registration"])
  vehicle_repairs_and_maintenance=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Vehicle Repairs and Maintenance"])
  driver_revenue=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Driver Revenue"])
  rental_revenue=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Rental Revenue"])
  rental_fleet_maintenance=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Rental Fleet Maintenance"])
  sales_taxes=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Sales Taxes"])
  income_taxes=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Income Tax"])
  dividends=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Dividends"])
  
  gain_on_disposal_of_assets=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Other Income"])
  loss_on_disposal_of_assets=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Other Loss"])
  
  salary_expenses=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Salary Expenses"])
  payroll_tax_expenses=sum(is_account_balance_df$Balance[is_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Employer Payroll Tax Expense"])

  #Add adjustment to income statement items for when a vehicle is rented out.
  rental_fleet_licensing=sum(rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Licensing[rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Date>=start_date&rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Date<=end_date])
  
  rental_fleet_insurance=sum(rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Insurance[rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Date>=start_date&rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Date<=end_date])
  
  rental_fleet_depreciation=sum(rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Depreciation[rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Date>=start_date&rental_adjustment_transaction_df$Date<=end_date])
  
  vehicle_licensing_and_registration=vehicle_licensing_and_registration-rental_fleet_licensing
  insurance=insurance-rental_fleet_insurance
  depreciation=depreciation-rental_fleet_depreciation
  
  #Calculate Income Statement Values. This will group general account items into more general income state line items.
  sga=administrative_expenses+advertising+salary_expenses
  
  vehicle_expenses=vehicle_accessories+vehicle_cleaning+vehicle_licensing_and_registration+vehicle_repairs_and_maintenance+tlc_rental+depreciation+insurance
  
  fuel_expenses=gas+electricity-fleet_carma_rewards
  
  driver_expenses=vehicle_expenses+fuel_expenses+driver_licensing+tolls+parking
  
  net_driver_revenue=driver_revenue-driver_expenses
  
  net_rental_revenue=rental_revenue-sales_taxes
  
  gross_revenue=net_rental_revenue+driver_revenue
  
  net_revenue=net_rental_revenue+net_driver_revenue
  
  rental_fleet_expenses=rental_fleet_insurance+rental_fleet_licensing+rental_fleet_depreciation+rental_fleet_maintenance+bad_debt_expense
  
  other_net_income=gain_on_disposal_of_assets-loss_on_disposal_of_assets
  
  ebit=net_revenue-sga-rental_fleet_expenses+other_net_income
  
  ebt=ebit-interest
  
  tanzeel_ahmed_compensation=salary_expenses+payroll_tax_expenses
  
  net_income=ebt-income_taxes
  
  net_income_plus_tanzeel_salary=net_income+salary_expenses
  
  retained_earnings_increase=net_income-dividends
  
  #Divide Net Income into two segments. Selling, General, and Administrative Expenses will be divided by the propotion of Driver Segment Income and the Rental Segment Income.This does not include the interest paid on any outstanding loans, the gain and loss on the disposable of assets, or 
  driver_segment_income=net_driver_revenue*net_income/ebt
  rental_segment_income=(net_rental_revenue-rental_fleet_expenses)*net_income/ebt

  #Create Dataframe for the final income statement.Column names will have space indents.
  is_df=data.frame(gross_revenue,driver_revenue,driver_expenses,vehicle_expenses,fuel_expenses,driver_licensing, tolls,parking,net_driver_revenue,rental_revenue,sales_taxes,net_rental_revenue,net_revenue,sga,tanzeel_ahmed_compensation,rental_fleet_expenses,rental_fleet_insurance, rental_fleet_depreciation, rental_fleet_maintenance,rental_fleet_licensing,bad_debt_expense,other_net_income,ebit,interest,ebt,income_taxes,net_income,driver_segment_income,rental_segment_income,retained_earnings_increase,net_income_plus_tanzeel_salary)
  
  colnames(is_df)=c("GROSS REVENUE","Driver Revenue","Driver Expenses","Vehicle Expenses",    "Fuel Expenses","Driver Licensing","Tolls","Parking","Net Driver Revenue","RENTAL REVENUE","Sales Taxes","NET RENTAL REVENUE","NET REVENUE","Selling, General, and Administrative Expenses","Tanzeel Ahmed Compensation","RENTAL FLEET EXPENSES", "Rental Fleet Insurance", "Rental Fleet Depreciation", "Rental Fleet Maintenance","Rental Fleet Licensing","Bad Debt Expense","Other Net Income","EBIT","Interest","PRE-TAX INCOME","Income Tax","NET INCOME","Driver Segment Net Income","Rental Segment Net Income","Increase in Retained Earnings","Net Income Add Back Tanzeel Ahmed Salary")
  
  is_df=data.frame(Account=colnames(is_df),Amount=t(is_df))
  return(is_df)
}

#Break down income statements by month so I can determine AFTER-TAX profits by each month.
monthly_after_tax_income_statement_function=function(ledger,year_no,rental_adjustment_transaction_df){
  result_df=data.frame()
  start_date_vec=first_day_of_month_function(year_no)
  end_date_vec=last_day_of_month_function(year_no)
  for(i in 1:length(start_date_vec)){
    is_df=income_statement_function(ledger,start_date_vec[i],end_date_vec[i],rental_adjustment_transaction_df)
    month_label_vec=c(rep(as.character(month(i,label=FALSE)),nrow(is_df)))
    is_df=data.frame(is_df,Month=month_label_vec)
    result_df=rbind(result_df,is_df)
  }
  return(result_df)
}

```

With the income statement function, I can also calculate the balance sheet since retained earnings requires me to know the after-tax profit and dividends.

```{r Balance Sheet Calculations, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

balance_sheet_function=function(ledger,end_date,rental_adjustment_transaction_df){
  #Calculate Income Statement from the very beginning of the company up until the point you want to create a balance sheet. This allows you to look at cumulative profits and calculated retained earnings increases.
  
  start_date=as.Date(min(ledger$Date))
  end_date=as.Date(end_date)

  #Income Statement
  is_df=income_statement_function(ledger,start_date,end_date,rental_adjustment_transaction_df)
  
  #Account Balances of Balance Sheet Accounts
  bs_account_balance_df=ledger%>%
    filter(Date<=as.Date(end_date)&Statement=="Balance Sheet")%>%
    group_by(General_Account)%>%
    summarize(Balance=round(sum(Normal_Balance_Increase),2))
  
  #Assign the account balances to actual values.
  
  accumulated_depreciation=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Accumulated Depreciation"])
  cash=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Cash"])
  common_equity=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Common Equity"])
  gross_ppe=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Gross Property, Plant, and Equipment"])
  ltd=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Long-Term Debt"])
  payables=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Payables"])
  prepaid_expenses=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Prepaid Expenses"])
  receivables=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Balance[bs_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Receivables"])
  retained_earnings=sum(is_df$Amount[is_df$Account=="Increase in Retained Earnings"])
  short_term_debt=sum(bs_account_balance_df$Amount[bs_account_balance_df$Account=="Short-Term Debt"])

  #Calculate Balance Sheet Values
  net_ppe=gross_ppe-accumulated_depreciation
  receivables=receivables
  current_assets=cash+receivables+prepaid_expenses
  long_term_assets=net_ppe
  total_assets=current_assets+long_term_assets
  current_liabilities=payables
  long_term_liabilities=ltd
  total_liabilities=current_liabilities+long_term_liabilities
  total_equity=common_equity+retained_earnings
  total_liabilities_and_equity=total_liabilities+total_equity
  
  #Create Asset Imbalance Variable to assess whether the balance sheet balances. A positive imbalance means assets are overstated or liabilities and/or equity are understated.
  asset_imbalance=total_assets-total_liabilities_and_equity
  
  #Create dataframe for final balance sheet
  bs_df=data.frame(cash,
                      receivables,
                      prepaid_expenses,
                    current_assets,
                      gross_ppe,
                        accumulated_depreciation,
                      net_ppe,
                    long_term_assets,
                   total_assets,
                        payables,
                        short_term_debt,
                    current_liabilities,
                      ltd,
                    long_term_liabilities,
                   total_liabilities,
                      common_equity,
                      retained_earnings,
                   total_equity,
                   total_liabilities_and_equity,
                    asset_imbalance)                    
  colnames(bs_df)=c("Cash","Receivables","Prepaid Expenses","CURRENT ASSETS",
                    "Gross Property, Plant, and Equipment","Accumulated Depreciation",
                    "NET PROPERTY, PLANT, AND EQUIPMENT","Long-Term Assets","TOTAL ASSETS",
                    "Payables","Short-Term Debt","CURRENT LIABILITIES","Long-Term Debt",
                    "Long-Term Liabilities","TOTAL LIABILITIES","Common Equity",
                    "Retained Earnings","TOTAL EQUITY","TOTAL LIABILITIES AND EQUITY",
                    "Asset Imbalance")
  bs_df=data.frame(Account=colnames(bs_df),Amount=t(bs_df))
  return(bs_df)
}

```

With finalized versions of the income statement and balance sheet, I can also use the indirect method to calculated the statement of cash flows.

```{r Cash Flow Statements, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

cash_flow_statement_function=function(ledger,start_date,end_date,rental_adjustment_transaction_df){
  #Make sure the start and end dates are properly formatted
  start_date=as.Date(start_date)
  end_date=as.Date(end_date)
  
  #Account Balances of General Accounts
  cf_account_balance_df=ledger%>%
    filter(Date>=as.Date(start_date)&Date<=as.Date(end_date))%>%
    group_by(General_Account)%>%
    summarize(Balance=round(sum(Normal_Balance_Increase),2))
  
  is_df=income_statement_function(ledger,start_date,end_date,rental_adjustment_transaction_df)
  
  #Assign the account balances to actual values. I Use sums in case financial statement query generates nulls. (i.e. Fleet Carma Rewards did not exist until I bought an electric car). Now that I have a rental adjustment transaction data frame, I can also calculate the rental fleet values to properly segment the income statement.

  net_income=is_df$Amount[is_df$Account=="NET INCOME"]
  
  depreciation=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Depreciation"])
  
  dividends=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Dividends"])
  
  receivables=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Receivables"])
  
  purchases=sum(ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase[ledger$General_Account=="Gross Property, Plant, and Equipment"&ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase>=0&ledger$Date>=start_date&ledger$Date<=end_date])
  
  gross_ppe_retirement=-sum(ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase[ledger$General_Account=="Gross Property, Plant, and Equipment"&ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase<0&ledger$Date>=start_date&ledger$Date<=end_date])
  
  #Accumulated Depreciation Retirement determines which debit to Accumulated Depreciation is associated with the retirement of a vehicle and not an adjusting entry that was calculated in the Depreciation and Amortization Table.
  accumulated_depreciation_retirement=-(sum(ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase[ledger$General_Account=="Accumulated Depreciation"&ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase<0&ledger$Date>=start_date&ledger$Date<=end_date])-sum(da_transaction_df$Credit[da_transaction_df$Sub_Account=="Accumulated Depreciation"&da_transaction_df$Date>=start_date&da_transaction_df$Date<=end_date&da_transaction_df$Credit<0]))
  
  prepaid_expenses=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Prepaid Expenses"])
  
  payables=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Payables"])
  
  gain_on_sale_assets=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Other Income"])
  
  loss_on_sale_assets=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Other Loss"])
  
  common_equity=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Common Equity"])
  
  ltd=sum(cf_account_balance_df$Balance[cf_account_balance_df$General_Account=="Long-Term Debt"])
  
  net_income=net_income-(gain_on_sale_assets-loss_on_sale_assets)
  #Summarize changes in operating, investing, and financing activities.
  
  operating_activities=net_income+depreciation+payables-prepaid_expenses-receivables
  
  #If assets are retired, then depreciation will be higher than the increase in accumulated depreciation
  sale_assets=gross_ppe_retirement+gain_on_sale_assets-loss_on_sale_assets-accumulated_depreciation_retirement
  
  investing_activities=-(purchases-sale_assets)
  
  financing_activities=common_equity+ltd-dividends
  
  cash_flow=operating_activities+investing_activities+financing_activities

  #Create Dataframe for the final income statement.Column names will have space indents.
  cf_df=data.frame(net_income,depreciation,payables,receivables,prepaid_expenses,operating_activities,sale_assets,purchases,investing_activities,common_equity,ltd,dividends,financing_activities,cash_flow)

  colnames(cf_df)=c("Net Income","Add Depreciation and Amortization","Add Increase in Payables","Minus Increase in Receivables","Minus Increase in Prepaid Expenses","Cash Flow from Operating Activities","Sale of Assets","Purchase of Assets","Cash Flow from Investing Activities","Issuance of Common Stock","Increase in Long-Term Debt","Minus Dividends","Cash Flows from Financing Activities","Net Cash Flow")
  cf_df=data.frame(Account=colnames(cf_df),Amount=t(cf_df))
  cf_df$Amount==round(cf_df$Amount,2)
  return(cf_df)
}

#Break down income statements by month so I can determine AFTER-TAX profits by each month.
monthly_cash_flow_statement_function=function(ledger,year_no,rental_adjustment_transaction_df){
  result_df=data.frame()
  start_date_vec=first_day_of_month_function(year_no)
  end_date_vec=last_day_of_month_function(year_no)
  for(i in 1:length(start_date_vec)){
    cf_df=cash_flow_statement_function(ledger,start_date_vec[i],end_date_vec[i],rental_adjustment_transaction_df)
    month_label_vec=c(rep(as.character(month(i,label=TRUE,abbr=FALSE)),nrow(cf_df)))
    cf_df=data.frame(cf_df,Month=month_label_vec)
    result_df=rbind(result_df,cf_df)
  }
  return(result_df)
}
```

I also calculate Notes to Financial Statements. For now, the most important notes related to vehicle maintenance. This requires the approximation of the odometer for each vehicle I own, since I cannot see the odometer every day when it's rented. Since there was a car accident in 2018 where my vehicle was struck by an irresponsible driver driving for a competing company, the vehicle maintenance figures need to be manually adjusted since I was reimbursed by insurance for both repair costs as well as inadequate compensation for lost wages.

```{r Cash Balances Reconciliation, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
#Add all end of quarter balances that are reported on the currently calculated Balance Sheets starting with Q4 2018 and ending with Q4 2025
bs_cash_balance_vec=c(bs_q4_2018$Amount[bs_q4_2018$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2019$Amount[bs_q1_2019$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2019$Amount[bs_q2_2019$Account=="Cash"],

                      bs_q1_2023$Amount[bs_q1_2023$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2023$Amount[bs_q2_2023$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2023$Amount[bs_q3_2023$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2023$Amount[bs_q4_2023$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2024$Amount[bs_q1_2024$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2024$Amount[bs_q2_2024$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2024$Amount[bs_q3_2024$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2024$Amount[bs_q4_2024$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2025$Amount[bs_q1_2025$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2025$Amount[bs_q2_2025$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2025$Amount[bs_q3_2025$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2025$Amount[bs_q4_2025$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2026$Amount[bs_q1_2026$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2026$Amount[bs_q2_2026$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2026$Amount[bs_q3_2026$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2026$Amount[bs_q4_2026$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2027$Amount[bs_q1_2027$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2027$Amount[bs_q2_2027$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2027$Amount[bs_q3_2027$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2027$Amount[bs_q4_2027$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2028$Amount[bs_q1_2025$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2028$Amount[bs_q2_2028$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2028$Amount[bs_q3_2028$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2028$Amount[bs_q4_2028$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2029$Amount[bs_q1_2029$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2029$Amount[bs_q2_2029$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2029$Amount[bs_q3_2029$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2029$Amount[bs_q4_2029$Account=="Cash"],
                      
                      bs_q1_2030$Amount[bs_q1_2030$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q2_2030$Amount[bs_q2_2030$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q3_2030$Amount[bs_q3_2030$Account=="Cash"],
                      bs_q4_2030$Amount[bs_q4_2030$Account=="Cash"])

#Calculate the neccessary adjustments it would take to accurately reflect the actual historical cash balances. Make sure the latter adjustments are adjusted to reflect previous adjustments
cash_difference_vec=cash_balance_vec-bs_cash_balance_vec

for(i in 2:length(cash_difference_vec)){
  cash_difference_vec[i]=cash_difference_vec[i]-sum(cash_difference_vec[1:(i-1)])
}

cash_reconciliation_date_vec=c(cash_balance_date_vec,cash_balance_date_vec)
cash_reconciliation_date_vec=cash_reconciliation_date_vec[order(cash_reconciliation_date_vec)]
cash_reconciliation_transaction_name_vec=rep("Cash Adjustment",length(cash_reconciliation_date_vec))
cash_reconciliation_transaction_debit_vec=c()
cash_reconciliation_transaction_credit_vec=c()
cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec=c()
cash_reconciliation_vehicle_vec=rep("Administrative",length(cash_reconciliation_date_vec))
cash_reconciliation_normal_balance_increase_vec=c()
cash_reconciliation_general_account_vec=c()
cash_reconciliation_statement_vec=c()

for(i in 1:length(cash_difference_vec)){
  cash_reconciliation_amount=abs(cash_difference_vec[i])
  if(cash_difference_vec[i]<0){
    cash_reconciliation_transaction_debit_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_transaction_debit_vec,cash_reconciliation_amount,0)
    cash_reconciliation_transaction_credit_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_transaction_credit_vec,0,cash_reconciliation_amount)
    cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec,"Dividends","Cash")
    cash_reconciliation_normal_balance_increase_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_normal_balance_increase_vec,cash_reconciliation_amount,-cash_reconciliation_amount)
  }else{
    cash_reconciliation_transaction_debit_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_transaction_debit_vec,cash_reconciliation_amount,0)
    cash_reconciliation_transaction_credit_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_transaction_credit_vec,0,cash_reconciliation_amount)
    cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec,"Cash","Common Equity")
    cash_reconciliation_normal_balance_increase_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_normal_balance_increase_vec,cash_reconciliation_amount,cash_reconciliation_amount)
  }
}

for(i in 1:length(cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec)){
  cash_reconciliation_general_account_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_general_account_vec,account_list_df$Account[account_list_df$Sub_Account==cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec[i]])
  
  cash_reconciliation_statement_vec=c(cash_reconciliation_statement_vec,account_list_df$Statement[account_list_df$Sub_Account==cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec[i]])
}

cash_reconciliation_transaction_df=data.frame(
  cash_reconciliation_date_vec,
  cash_reconciliation_transaction_name_vec,
  cash_reconciliation_transaction_debit_vec,
  cash_reconciliation_transaction_credit_vec,
  cash_reconciliation_sub_account_vec,
  cash_reconciliation_vehicle_vec,
  Verified="Y",
  Financial.Institution="Non-Cash",
  cash_reconciliation_normal_balance_increase_vec,
  cash_reconciliation_general_account_vec,
  cash_reconciliation_statement_vec)

colnames(cash_reconciliation_transaction_df)=colnames(final_general_ledger)

final_general_ledger=rbind(final_general_ledger,cash_reconciliation_transaction_df)
final_general_ledger=arrange(final_general_ledger,Date, Transaction, Debit)

```

### Cash Obligations

Next, let's predict the upcoming month's cash and bill payments by adding loan payments with cash and non-cash insurance, licensing, vehicle, TLC Rental (if applicable), and adminsitrative expenses. I'll also estimate incoming revenue for the next month given current rental clients as well as minimal Tanzeel Ahmed driver payouts from Uber and other ride-share services.

```{r Cash Obligations, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

first_day_of_next_month=min(first_day_of_month_function(current_year)[first_day_of_month_function(current_year)>Sys.Date()])

last_day_of_next_month=min(last_day_of_month_function(current_year)[last_day_of_month_function(current_year)>min(first_day_of_month_function(current_year)[first_day_of_month_function(current_year)>Sys.Date()])])

#No longer using loan transactions dataframe
#loan_payments_next_month=sum(loan_transactions$Credit[loan_transactions$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&loan_transactions$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&loan_transactions$Sub_Account=="Cash"])

long_term_debt_payments_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Long-Term Debt"])

short_term_debt_payments_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Short-Term Debt"])

current_portion_long_term_debt_payments_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Cuurent Portion of Long-Term Debt"])

loan_payments_next_month=rbind(long_term_debt_payments_next_month,short_term_debt_payments_next_month,current_portion_long_term_debt_payments_next_month)


credit_card_payments_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Credit Cards Payable"])

insurance_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Insurance"])

licensing_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="Vehicle Licensing and Registration"])

maintenance_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="Vehicle Repairs and Maintenance"])

vehicle_accessories_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="Vehicle Accessories"])

administrative_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="Administrative Expenses"])

tlc_rental_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Debit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="TLC Rental"])
  
driver_revenue_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Credit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="Driver Revenue"])  
rental_revenue_next_month=sum(final_general_ledger$Credit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="Rental Revenue"])

next_month_expenses=sum(administrative_next_month,vehicle_accessories_next_month,maintenance_next_month,licensing_next_month,insurance_next_month,loan_payments_next_month,tlc_rental_next_month,credit_card_payments_next_month)

free_cash_next_month=driver_revenue_next_month+rental_revenue_next_month-next_month_expenses

min_tanzeel_paycheck=mean(final_general_ledger$Credit[final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_next_month&final_general_ledger$General_Account=="Driver Revenue"])
```

Over the next month, the company expects to spend **\$ `r format(round(loan_payments_next_month,2), big.mark=",", scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on paying off loans, **\$ `r format(round(credit_card_payments_next_month,2), big.mark=",", scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on paying off Credit Card Payments, **\$ `r format(round(tlc_rental_next_month,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on TLC Rentals, **\$ `r format(round(insurance_next_month,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on insurance (including non-cash amortizations that may be reflected in current credit card payments), **\$ `r format(round(licensing_next_month,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on licensing, **\$ `r format(round(maintenance_next_month,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on maintenance, **\$ `r format(round(vehicle_accessories_next_month,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on vehicle accessories, **\$ `r format(round(administrative_next_month,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars on other administrative expenses.

At the same time, the company expects to receive **\$ `r format(round((driver_revenue_next_month+rental_revenue_next_month),2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars from its current rental clients and Mr. Tanzeel Ahmed's driving, assuming a minimum driver payout of **\$ `r format(round(min_tanzeel_paycheck,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** dollars per week during the next month.

This means the company's immediate ongoing operations will yield an additional **\$ `r format(round(free_cash_next_month,2),big.mark=",",scientific=FALSE)`** that can be used to service additional debt, reduce current debt, make further investments in the company's expansion, or for sudden expenses.

### Financial Ratios

```{r Financial Ratios, include= FALSE, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
#Remember, since this is a service based business, there are no inventories to affect the quick ratio.

financial_ratio_function=function(is,bs){
  cash=bs$Amount[bs$Account=="Cash"]
  working_capital=bs$Amount[bs$Account=="CURRENT ASSETS"]-bs$Amount[bs$Account=="CURRENT LIABILITIES"]
  short_term_debt=bs$Amount[bs$Account=="Short-Term Debt"]
  long_term_debt=bs$Amount[bs$Account=="Long-Term Debt"]
  net_income=is$Amount[is$Account=="NET INCOME"]
  driver_net_income=is$Amount[is$Account=="Driver Segment Net Income"]
  rental_net_income=is$Amount[is$Account=="Rental Segment Net Income"]
  
  #Final Ratios
  quick_ratio=cash/working_capital
  debt_to_equity=(short_term_debt+long_term_debt)/bs$Amount[bs$Account=="TOTAL EQUITY"]
  return_on_assets=net_income/bs$Amount[bs$Account=="TOTAL ASSETS"]
  return_on_equity=net_income/bs$Amount[bs$Account=="TOTAL EQUITY"]
  rental_net_margin=rental_net_income/is$Amount[is$Account=="RENTAL REVENUE"]
  net_margin=net_income/is$Amount[is$Account=="GROSS REVENUE"]
  
  # Summarize ratios
  df=data.frame(Quick_Ratio=quick_ratio,Debt_to_Equity_Ratio=debt_to_equity,ROA_Pct=round(return_on_assets*100,2),ROE_Pct=round(return_on_equity*100,2),Rental_Profit_Margin_Pct=round(rental_net_margin*100,2),Net_Profit_Margin_Pct=round(net_margin*100,2))
  return(df)
}
```

### Data Preparation for Visualization, these only include up to the last month I drove ride-share

Let's use the dplyr package to calculate dataframes that will summarize income statements by month. I'll also add labels detailing the quarter to aid in future ggplot visualizations. I also apportion the company into its two operating segments: driving and revenue.

```{r Net Income Dataframes for visualization, warning=FALSE ,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

#Create dataframe that summarizes income statement items on a monthly basis
final_monthly_is_df=data.frame()

for(i in 2018:max_year){
  monthly_is_df=monthly_after_tax_income_statement_function(final_general_ledger,i,rental_adjustment_transaction_df)
  year_vec=c(rep(i,nrow(monthly_is_df)))
  
  monthly_is_df=data.frame(monthly_is_df,Year=year_vec)
  
  #Combine Month and Year Columns into one Vector to Assist in Labeling any Data Visualizations
  month_label_vec=c()
  for(j in 1:nrow(monthly_is_df)){
    month_label=(paste(as.character(monthly_is_df$Month[j]),'-',as.character(monthly_is_df$Year[j])))
    month_label_vec=c(month_label_vec,month_label)
  }
  
  monthly_is_df=data.frame(monthly_is_df,Month_Label=month_label_vec)
  final_monthly_is_df=rbind(final_monthly_is_df,monthly_is_df)
}

#Determine the Quarter based on month
quarter_no_vec=c()

for(i in 1:nrow(final_monthly_is_df)){
  if(final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="January"||final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="February"||final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="March"){
    quarter_no="Q1"
  }else if(final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="April"||final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="May"||final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="June"){
    quarter_no="Q2"
  }else if(final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="July"||final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="August"||final_monthly_is_df$Month[i]=="September"){
    quarter_no="Q3"
  }else{
    quarter_no="Q4"
  }
  quarter_no_vec=c(quarter_no_vec,quarter_no)
}

quarter_label_vec=c()
for(i in 1:nrow(final_monthly_is_df)){
  quarter_label=paste(as.character(quarter_no_vec[i]),as.character(final_monthly_is_df$Year[i]))
  quarter_label_vec=c(quarter_label_vec,quarter_label)
}

final_monthly_is_df=data.frame(final_monthly_is_df,Quarter=quarter_no_vec,Quarter_Label=quarter_label_vec)

#Filter the dataframe to only show when revenue occurred. THis is because predictable expenses are already calculated before revenue is, which makes it seem as if in the new year, I lose money.
unique_quarters=unique(final_monthly_is_df$Quarter_Label)
include_quarter_vec=c()


#for(i in 1:length(unique_quarters)){
  #if(sum(final_monthly_is_df$Amount[final_monthly_is_df$Account=="Driver Revenue"&final_monthly_is_df$Quarter_Label==unique_quarters[i]])>0){
    #include_quarter=TRUE
  #}else{
    #include_quarter=FALSE
  #}
  #include_quarter_vec=c(include_quarter_vec,include_quarter)
#}

#Replace prior loop to make sure all quarters are included
include_quarter_vec=c(rep(TRUE,length(unique_quarters)))

include_quarter_df=data.frame(Quarter=unique_quarters,Include=include_quarter_vec)

complete_final_monthly_is_df=data.frame()
for(i in 1:nrow(include_quarter_df)){
  if(include_quarter_df$Include[i]==TRUE){
    complete_final_monthly_is_subset=subset(final_monthly_is_df,final_monthly_is_df$Quarter_Label==include_quarter_df$Quarter[i])
  }else{
    complete_final_monthly_is_subset=data.frame()
  }
  complete_final_monthly_is_df=rbind(complete_final_monthly_is_df,complete_final_monthly_is_subset)
}

final_monthly_is_df=complete_final_monthly_is_df
```

```{r Tax Items, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
recent_tax_year=year(Sys.Date())-1

vehicle_list=unique(final_general_ledger$Vehicle)
vehicle_list=vehicle_list[vehicle_list!="Administrative"]
vehicle_tax_expense_list=c("Interest","Insurance","Vehicle Repairs and Maintenance","Gas","Parking","Electricity","Vehicle Cleaning","Vehicle Accessorites","Vehicle Licensing and Registration","Fleet Carma Rewards","Bad Debt Expense","TLC Rental","Tolls", "Rental Fleet Maintenance", "Rental Fleet Insurance")

vehicle_tax_expense_df=data.frame()
for(j in 1:length(vehicle_tax_expense_list)){
  vehicle_vector=c()
  vehicle_amount=c()
for(i in 1:length(vehicle_list)){
  vehicle=vehicle_list[i]
  amount=sum(final_general_ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase[final_general_ledger$General_Account==vehicle_tax_expense_list[j]&final_general_ledger$Vehicle==vehicle&final_general_ledger$Date>=first_day_of_year_function(recent_tax_year)&final_general_ledger$Date<=last_day_of_year_function(recent_tax_year)])
  vehicle_vector=c(vehicle_vector,vehicle)
  vehicle_amount=c(vehicle_amount,amount)
}
  df=data.frame(Vehicle=vehicle_vector,Account=c(rep(vehicle_tax_expense_list[j],length(vehicle_list))),Amount=vehicle_amount)
  vehicle_tax_expense_df=rbind(vehicle_tax_expense_df,df)
}

vehicle_tax_expense_df$Amount=round(vehicle_tax_expense_df$Amount,2)
```

```{r Sales Tax Items, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
insurance_cash_transactions=general_ledger[general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Prepaid Insurance"&general_ledger$Date>=ny_sales_tax_start_date&general_ledger$Date<=ny_sales_tax_end_date,]

normal_balance_increase_insurance_cash_transactions=insurance_cash_transactions%>%group_by(Vehicle)%>%summarize(Total=sum(Debit)-sum(Credit))


for(i in 1:length(unique_vehicles_cleaned)){
  net_rental_revenue=sum(final_general_ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase[final_general_ledger$Vehicle==unique_vehicles_cleaned[i]&final_general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Rental Revenue"&final_general_ledger$Date>=ny_sales_tax_start_date&final_general_ledger$Date<=ny_sales_tax_end_date])
  print(paste(unique_vehicles_cleaned[i],"Rent not including Security Deposits Forfeited $",round(net_rental_revenue,2)))
  

  rental_fleet_maintenance=sum(final_general_ledger$Normal_Balance_Increase[final_general_ledger$Vehicle==unique_vehicles_cleaned[i]&final_general_ledger$Sub_Account=="Rental Fleet Maintenance"&final_general_ledger$Date>=ny_sales_tax_start_date&final_general_ledger$Date<=ny_sales_tax_end_date])

print(paste(unique_vehicles_cleaned[i],"Rental Fleet Maintenance $",round(rental_fleet_maintenance,2)))

print(paste(unique_vehicles_cleaned[i],"Rental Fleet Insurance $",round(rental_insurance_by_vehicle$Total[i],2)))

rental_revenue_including_sales_tax=round(net_rental_revenue,2)-round(rental_fleet_maintenance,2)-round(rental_insurance_by_vehicle$Total[i],2)

if(Sys.Date()<ny_sales_tax_due_date){
  effective_sales_tax_rate=ny_sales_tax_rate*(1-ny_sales_tax_discount_rate)/(1+ny_sales_tax_rate*(1-ny_sales_tax_discount_rate))
  }else{
  effective_sales_tax_rate=ny_sales_tax_rate/(1+ny_sales_tax_rate)
  }

sales_tax=round(rental_revenue_including_sales_tax*effective_sales_tax_rate,2)
final_rental_revenue=rental_revenue_including_sales_tax-sales_tax

print(paste(unique_vehicles_cleaned[i],"Rental Revenue including Sales Taxes $",rental_revenue_including_sales_tax))

print(paste(unique_vehicles_cleaned[i],"Sales Taxes $",sales_tax))
print(paste(unique_vehicles_cleaned[i],"Gross Revenue to be Reported $",final_rental_revenue))
}


```

The total insurance, as calculated by accrual basis accounting and properly amortizing down payments and insurance installments throughout the relevant rental periods (i.e. I'm not including the TLC insurance during periods where a given vehicle is not rented since Tanzeel Ahmed will drive said vehicle for ride-share services respectively).

For the purposes of calculating the proper vehicle expenses by vehicle for tax filings, I've created the vehicle expense data frame which sorts annual expenses for the necessary tax items by vehicle for the previous tax year by vehicle.

When adding new drivers, especially towards the end of the year, the amortization of additional down payments and reductions in future installments after removing rented clients can add short-term volatility to insurance costs. However, these fluctuations are minor relative to the basic level of insurance The Company is required to maintain for its fleet.

Shorter-term rentals are the only rentals that can make the amortized insurance appear more volatile, especially if they are towards the end of the year. However, in the next year, the amortized contra-transaction of the down payment (i.e. a down payment for an extra driver is for one year but the renter returns the vehicle significantly earlier), will cancel out this fluctuation.

Negative numbers can appear for the Vehicle Repairs and Maintenance category if there was an accident where The Company was reimbursed by the offending party for the compensatory costs and additional funds to account for the lost driver wages resulting from the temporarily damaged state of The Company's vehicles.
